# American Association of Critical-Care Nurses (AACN)

> AACN is the world's largest critical-care nursing organization, providing board certification, continuing education, clinical resources, and professional development for acute and critical-care nurses.

AACN serves critical-care nurses through comprehensive education programs, evidence-based clinical resources, board certification pathways, and advocacy for healthy work environments. The organization hosts major conferences like NTI (National Teaching Institute), operates local chapters, and offers specialized programs including the CSI Academy for nurse leadership and quality improvement.

## Key Topics

- Critical-Care Nursing
- Board Certification
- Continuing Education
- Healthy Work Environments
- Clinical Excellence

## Membership & Core Services

- [American Association of Critical-Care Nurses - AACN](https://www.aacn.org): AACN homepage: world's largest critical-care nursing organization
- [Join AACN](https://www.aacn.org/membership): AACN membership options and professional development benefits
- [Chapters: An Important Part of AACN](https://www.aacn.org/nursing-excellence/chapters): AACN local chapters for networking and professional engagement

## Certification & Professional Development

- [Board Certification](https://www.aacn.org/certification): AACN board certification for acute and critical-care nursing
- [Education](https://www.aacn.org/education): AACN education hub: webinars, courses, podcasts, and CE activities
- [Online Courses](https://www.aacn.org/education/online-courses): AACN online nursing courses and certification review programs
- [Continuing Education Activities](https://www.aacn.org/education/ce-activities): AACN continuing education activities and professional development
- [AACN Continuing Professional Development Scholarships](https://www.aacn.org/education/scholarship): AACN scholarships for continuing professional development

## Educational Programs & Resources

- [Webinar Series](https://www.aacn.org/education/webinar-series): AACN Critical Care Webinar Series with continuing education credits
- [Podcast Series](https://www.aacn.org/education/podcast-series): Voices in Nursing Podcast and COVID-19 educational series
- [Clinical Resources](https://www.aacn.org/clinical-resources): AACN clinical resource library and evidence-based practice guides
- [AACN Clinical Scene Investigator (CSI) Academy](https://www.aacn.org/nursing-excellence/csi-academy): CSI Academy: nurse leadership and quality improvement program

## Nursing Excellence & Standards

- [Nursing Excellence](https://www.aacn.org/nursing-excellence): AACN nursing excellence programs, awards, and healthy work standards
- [Healthy Work Environments](https://www.aacn.org/nursing-excellence/healthy-work-environments): AACN Healthy Work Environments standards and organizational guidelines
- [Excellence Awards](https://www.aacn.org/nursing-excellence/excellence-awards): AACN excellence awards and Circle of Excellence recognition

## Conferences & Events

- [Conferences & Events](https://www.aacn.org/conferences-and-events): AACN conferences including NTI 2026, 2027 and local chapter events
